 Aeryka A. Walker
 Linn County Jail 
 An area woman, while living in Marion, Cedar Rapids and Palo, is accused of underreporting her income to the state for years and collecting $21,789 in SNAP benefits she was not entitled to, according to a Linn County criminal complaint.
 Investigators with the Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals and Licensing found that Aeryka Walker, 38, provided false documentation and made false statements to the Iowa Department of Health and Human Services regarding her income between July 2024 and July 2026, according to the criminal complaint.
 Investigators said Walker underreported her income or claimed she had no income when records show she was working and receiving regular pay.
 Walker has been charged with ongoing criminal conduct, a Class B felony punishable by up to 25 years in prison, and first-degree fraudulent practice, a Class C felony punishable by up to 10 years in prison.
 She is being held in the Linn County Jail on a $35,000 cash or surety bond.
